subject: Publisher onboarding: sequencing for offer proof exchange and mini-sprint
messages:
From: David Harris <david.harris@contoso.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Azure Marketplace Team <marketplace@contoso.com>
Date: 2026-09-27T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Offer kickoff: sequencing and what we need from Redwood

Hi Chloe / Marissa,

Thanks for taking this on. Contoso is ready to move our pilot of Redwood Inference into the Marketplace sandbox. Before we hand off to our ISV ops, we need a short, concrete preflight list from you so we can schedule a 2-week mini-sprint to get the offer created and validated. High-level asks from our side: 

- A draft offer manifest (SKU mapping, plan names, billing hints) we can drop into the portal.
- Technical validation checklist (endpoints, healthcheck, telemetry/metrics expected, recommended quotas).
- A service principal (or instructions to create one) with the minimal permissions you need in our staging tenant for validation.
- Any sample artifacts or stubs (ARM/SaaS connector, sample billing mapping).

We can provision a Contoso staging tenant and add the SPN you provide. Ideally we want a short smoke test run by your team in that tenant on day 2 of the mini-sprint.

Attachments: Contoso will attach the tenant provisioning guide from our side once the schedule is locked.

Can you send a 3-step plan (tasks, owners, 2-week schedule) and the initial manifest by COB tomorrow?

Thanks,
David
David Harris
Product Partnerships, Contoso Cloud

From: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>
To: David Harris <david.harris@contoso.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-27T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Offer kickoff: sequencing and what we need from Redwood

David — thanks, this is clear. Quick proposal below (3-step mini-sprint) and a draft manifest attached (redwood-offer-manifest-v1.json).

Mini-sprint (two weeks):
1) Day 0-2: Access + manifest delivery
   - Owner: Chloe (project coordination)
   - Deliverables: draft manifest, SPN permissions matrix, staging runbook link (see related links)
2) Day 3-7: Validation sprint (runtime smoke tests)
   - Owner: Marissa (tech lead)
   - Deliverables: healthchecks, latency/throughput baseline, sample telemetry events
3) Day 8-12: Offer portal prep + submit
   - Owner: Vivek (product ops)
   - Deliverables: portal listing assets, co-sell metadata, pricing SKU mapping

I attached the manifest draft and a short checklist. A couple of notes:
- For the SPN, we recommend Contributor on the test resource group (we only need limited access to deploy a lightweight staging connector and run smoke tests).
- We'll run a 30-minute sync on Day 1 (morning PT) to confirm access and the test plan.
- If Contoso requires tighter roles (e.g., no Contributor), we can adapt but will need a slightly longer validation window.

Attachments: redwood-offer-manifest-v1.json (manifest draft)

Let me know if the timeline works and paste the staging tenant id + contact for your ops person and we'll schedule the Day 1 sync.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Partner Success Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: David Harris <david.harris@contoso.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-27T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Offer kickoff: sequencing and what we need from Redwood

Adding a few technical validation specifics so Contoso's infra team can provision appropriately. Quoted original below.

Marissa's validation checklist (concise):
- Endpoint types: SaaS connector (POST/GET), healthcheck endpoint returning 200 + JSON schema sample.
- Auth: SPN with client_id/secret and permissions to create a test resource (we only need to upload a staging manifest and call the SaaS connector).
- Telemetry: sample events we ingest (request_id, model_name, tokens_in/tokens_out, latency_ms). Please reserve a small EventHub or storage account in staging we can write to.
- Networking: If you require PrivateLink, provide the Private Endpoint IP range and we will test connectivity.
- Runtime: we'll run a 5-minute continuous token generation at two sequence lengths to capture memory/KV behavior (helps us confirm kernel selection).

Operational ask: please add redwood-staging-spn@contoso to the test resource group with Contributor for the 2-week window. We'll rotate the secret and provide a new one if the tenant prefers.

Attachment note: I embedded small inline examples in the draft manifest (see attached). If anything in the manifest conflicts with your naming conventions, flag it and we'll adapt quickly.
